notes: WV 2010 vintage used directly (no substitution). URL convention differs from 2015: 2010 uses `chapter06b/` (lowercase, no dash) and `6B-N-N.html` per-section leaves with uppercase letters for variants (e.g., `6B-3-3A.html`); 2015 used `chapter-6b/` and `section-6b-N-N/`. State→chapter06b→article-{1,2,3}→per-section .html leaves; tree depth 4, so pass-3 fired on each of the 3 chosen articles. Single regime: Chapter 6B Ethics Act houses lobbying disclosure (Article 3) plus enforcement scaffolding (Articles 1-2). Article 2A (Rules) excluded — procedural rule-making bookkeeping, not statute. 14 core_chapter URLs (all of Article 3) + 10 support_chapter URLs (definitions/penalties in Article 1; Ethics Commission enforcement chain in Article 2, excluding officials' financial-disclosure sections 5/5a/5b/6/7/8 and empty §6B-2-11). 2010's Article 1 has two extra boilerplate sections vs 2015 (6B-1-5 severability, 6B-1-6 deposit of funds) — both excluded as not cross-referenced from the lobbying chapter. Total URL count (24) matches 2015. Cloudflare clear on all 5 Playwright fetches.
